notes.text: Peerlist first-time profile completion is split into two layers: a modal onboarding dialog and the main /user/settings/profile form. The modal must be completed first, then the main form still needs Save. Interaction gate remained at 35% after name, bio, website, Twitter, 3 skills, and location were added, so unlocking 40% likely needs an additional profile signal such as avatar or another supported field.

[success verification] Profile title changed to [User Name] • Peerlist and the saved settings page shows first name [First], last name [Last], headline, GitHub website, Twitter username, 3 selected skills, and [City, Country] as location.
